learning_outcomes.text: Based on specifications requiring the design of a product in different versions, students should be able to create an interactive digital mock-up in CATIA V5, driven by an Excel sheet.
Determine the functional dimensions of a planar mechanism by drawing sketches on Catia
Generate component families and create catalogs
Perform modular design by publishing functional surfaces

syllabus_topics: learning how to create CAD drawings
learning how to create Excel-driven part families
learning how to replace components using surface publications
production of a mini synthesis project
teaching_methods: Work sessions in the design office, in pairs on a computer workstation equipped with CATIA V5 software
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
